sources.title: Phoenix REALTORS - Office Hours + Info
sources.notes: Official page confirms address 7878 N 16th St, Suite #150, Phoenix, AZ 85020, phone 602.246.1012, email info@phoenixrealtors.com, website, and office hours Monday-Friday 8:00AM to 4:00PM.

sources.title: Phoenix REALTORS - Member Benefits
sources.notes: Official benefits page describes free CE classes, MarketStats tools, listing media services, Rayse, domii, local discounts, REALTOR store deliveries, office space reservations, store member pricing, and member cafe.

sources.title: Phoenix REALTORS - How It Works
sources.notes: Official page explains that joining the local association also includes state and national association membership with Arizona Association of REALTORS and National Association of REALTORS.

sources.title: Phoenix REALTORS - Market Stats
sources.notes: Official page says Phoenix REALTORS provides market statistics reports based on ARMLS data for primarily the Phoenix-metro area and surrounding Arizona communities.

sources.title: Phoenix REALTORS - Code of Ethics
sources.notes: Official page covers Code of Ethics training requirements and resources, including the January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2027 current cycle.
